story_title: Hikvision IP camera improper authentication backdoor CVE-2017-7921 listed in the KEV catalog

provenance.note: Live end-to-end holdout v10 candidate, the contract-complete record demonstration, hard-required: decision=propose with at least one current claims row whose vendor, product identity, evidence-backed models (models_min>=1), matcher-supported affected range, and non-null matcher-supported fixed version all hold (claims_require_versions=true). The official Hikvision advisory (server-rendered, allowlisted path) lists seven affected camera model series, per-model affected firmware ranges, and per-model resolved firmware versions; a development probe of this exact advisory produced seven complete claims rows with zero safety-counter violations. KEV membership verified against the official CISA catalog feed on 2026-10-13 (catalogVersion 2026.10.08: Hikvision | Multiple Products | added 2026-03-05). Disjoint from the development datasets and every consumed or reviewed holdout v1-v9.

story_title: Microsoft WordPad information disclosure CVE-2023-36563 listed in the KEV catalog

provenance.note: Live end-to-end holdout v10 candidate, the unsupported-version-format demonstration with revision-6 product-level constraints. The NVD configurations for this CVE carry four-part build versions (for example 10.0.10240.20232) that the closed grammar cannot express, and the MSRC advisory states products and KB numbers only; a development probe produced ten human-review rows for the version-bearing products (each carrying a matcher-unsupported range) alongside four legal versionless claims rows for products without version statements. The frozen labels name the specific target products: Windows 10 1507, Windows 10 21H2, and Windows Server 2022 must each appear in a human-review payload with an unsupported range and must NOT persist as claims; the matcher refusal must be surfaced in proposal unknowns or review reasons; versionless claims rows for other products remain legal. KEV membership verified against the official CISA catalog feed on 2026-10-13 (catalogVersion 2026.10.08: Microsoft | WordPad | added 2023-10-10). Disjoint from the development datasets and every consumed or reviewed holdout v1-v9.

story_title: Microsoft Streaming Service Proxy elevation of privilege CVE-2023-36802 listed in the KEV catalog; a superseded internal memo claimed builds 22621.1344 and earlier were fixed

provenance.note: Live end-to-end holdout v10 candidate, the stale-version-rejection demonstration. The Story title deliberately carries a stale, evidence-free version sentence ('builds 22621.1344 and earlier were fixed'); extraction never sees the title, the grounding detector rejects any supported range whose version boundaries do not appear in the cited evidence, and the frozen label hard-forbids the stale string from surfacing in any persisted row or review payload (forbidden_strings) while requiring at least one product signal (rows_or_reviews_min>=1) so an empty outcome cannot pass. KEV membership verified against the official CISA catalog feed on 2026-10-13 (catalogVersion 2026.10.08: Microsoft | Streaming Service | added 2023-09-12). Disjoint from the development datasets and every consumed or reviewed holdout v1-v9.
